Multiplayer Marker v2.1 (optional, not on the website)
Gathering hall only: other players who run the Multiplayer Armor and/or Weapon Transmog codes
get a ° in front of their name (name tags and player list). Your own name never changes.
Only you see the marker; it doesn't change anything that is sent or saved.

## PPSSPP
